conditions: A Contributor distributes the Program in object code form under its own license agreement and relies on section 3.
limitations: The claim covers the content of the separate agreement under section 3(b)(iv). Section 3(a), the other conditions, and the later source-form paragraph have their own scope.
The adequacy of a particular source or access channel depends on facts beyond the claim.

triggers: Eclipse or SPDX changes the document, publication authority, metadata, or cited locator.

statement: Eclipse Public License 1.0 section 3(b)(iv) requires a Contributor distributing the Program in object code under its own license agreement to state in that agreement that the Program source is available from that Contributor and inform licensees how to obtain it reasonably on or through a medium customarily used to exchange software.
